data.title: Place Value Explorers with Base-Ten Blocks
data.description: Discover how numbers are made of hundreds, tens, and ones, and learn how to build, trade, and add using base-ten blocks.

challenges.hint: Start by placing the blocks for the largest place value column first.

challenges.instruction: Count the blocks on the mat to find the total value.
challenges.hint: Count the hundreds blocks, then the tens rods, and finally the ones units.

challenges.instruction: Perform a trade with the blocks on your mat.
challenges.hint: Remember that one larger block can be traded for ten of the next smaller blocks.
Combine your blocks and remember to regroup when you have ten or more in any column.
